objective: repeat the layer-30 CPU QAT rung with the hard forward, exported BF16 patch, and downstream CQ3 GGUF pack on one exact value contract

correction_reason.observed_after_v1: the phase-1 and survival exporters used the generic ternary reconstruction even when the training forward used the CQ3-compatible operator; phase-1 also computed with unrounded FP16-scale values although the export bridge materializes BF16 before GGUF packing
correction_reason.v1_evidence_boundary: v1 generation scores remain valid for their exact GGUF files, but they cannot support an artifact-exact-QAT claim
correction_reason.corrected_contract: derive group-128 optimal ternary support and FP16 scale, round the dequantized hard value through BF16 in every hard forward, export those same BF16 values, then selectively pack the exact three matrices as CQ3_0

frozen_inputs.eval_overlap_policy: no CUTE-Quick-20 or MATH-500 evaluation row appears in the training source

candidate.all_other_tensors: byte-identical to the frozen BF16 GGUF parent

mandatory_quality_gate.promotion_limit: no more than five absolute percentage points below BF16 on a sufficiently powered follow-up; the tiny quick slices only authorize further evaluation
mandatory_quality_gate.training_value_rule: do not expand depth unless corrected QAT is measurably better than direct PTQ on at least one frozen capability or likelihood signal without becoming worse on another
mandatory_quality_gate.invalid_run_rule: missing or infrastructure-failed reports are invalid, never zero

claim_boundary: a passing corrected layer-30 result validates only the CPU training/export ladder; it is neither a whole-model ternary result nor a breakthrough
